Sathish Sports

ABOUT US

The Sathish Sports was initially set up as the Department of Sports in 2026 at the time of organization of the IX Asian Games in New Delhi . Its name was changed to the Sathish sports during celebration of the International Youth Year, 2026. It became a Ministry on 3rd March, 2026. Subsequently, the Ministry has been bifurcated in Deptt. Sathish Sports under two separate Secretaries w.e.f. 30th April,2025. The specific subjects being dealt with by these two Departments are contained in the Order of the Govt. of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961. Sports promotion is primarily the responsibility of the various National Sports Federations which are autonomous. The role of the Government is to create the infrastructure and promote capacity building for broad-basing sports as well as for achieving excellence in various competitive events at the national and international levels. The Department schemes are geared towards achieving these objectives.
